note: The documentary reader's viewpoints (lens_set "documentary" in notes.json). Same colour families, verdicts and anchor method as lenses.json; built from documentary practice (Bernard, Documentary Storytelling; common commissioning criteria) plus ethics, access and archive, which fiction readers don't need. A consent/release checklist is out of scope by the user's choice; the ethics viewpoint still flags representation and marking of reconstructions.

lenses.name: Story and structure
ask: Is there a question or a want that pulls us through, and does each section move it?
Can the shoot deliver the ending this plan needs, and what if it doesn't (a fallback)?
Does the structure chosen fit what will really happen in front of the camera?
lenses.evidence: sections in order; what each one changes; the planned ending and whether it depends on events nobody controls

green.en: A clear question pulls through every section, and the ending holds even if events change.
green.ar: هناك سؤال واضح يشدّ عبر كل الأقسام، والنهاية تصمد حتى لو تغيّرت الأحداث.

amber.en: The drive is there but some sections stand still, or the ending depends on one event with no fallback.
amber.ar: الدافع موجود لكن بعض الأقسام تقف مكانها، أو النهاية معلّقة على حدث واحد دون بديل.

red.en: No question or want pulls the film forward: it is a list of scenes about a topic.
red.ar: لا سؤال ولا رغبة تدفع الفيلم: إنه قائمة مشاهد عن موضوع.

lenses.name: Point of view and voice
ask: Whose film is this, and where does the filmmaker stand?
Do narration, titles and interviews follow the approach the filmmaker chose (e.g. no voice-over)?
Is the film's voice consistent from start to end?
lenses.evidence: narration lines, on-screen titles, interviewer presence; the filmmaker's stated approach (intent sheet or proposal)

green.en: One clear point of view; every voice device follows the chosen approach.
green.ar: وجهة نظر واحدة واضحة؛ كل أدوات الصوت تتبع الأسلوب المختار.

amber.en: The point of view is there but some devices (a narration line, a title) work against the chosen approach.
amber.ar: وجهة النظر موجودة لكن بعض الأدوات (سطر تعليق، عنوان) تعمل ضد الأسلوب المختار.

red.en: The film doesn't know whose eyes we see through, or its voice contradicts what the filmmaker set out to do.
red.ar: الفيلم لا يعرف بعين من نرى، أو صوته يناقض ما أراده صانعه.

lenses.name: Evidence and accuracy
ask: Which statements are presented as fact (titles, narration, captions), and is each one sourced or checkable?
Are numbers, dates and superlatives («the last», «the biggest») verified?
Does anything claim more than the footage or the sources can show?
lenses.evidence: every factual claim in titles, narration and captions; whether a source is named

green.en: Every factual claim is sourced, or phrased as the person's own view.
green.ar: كل معلومة مقدَّمة كحقيقة لها مصدر، أو مصوغة كرأي صاحبها.

amber.en: Some claims are unsourced, or a superlative needs checking.
amber.ar: بعض المعلومات بلا مصدر، أو هناك صيغة تفضيل («الأخير»، «الأكبر») تحتاج تحققاً.

red.en: A central claim the film rests on is unverified or likely wrong.
red.ar: معلومة مركزية يقوم عليها الفيلم غير متحقق منها أو على الأرجح خاطئة.

lenses.name: Real people
ask: Are the subjects full people (wants, contradictions, humour), or illustrations of a point?
Do we see them do things, not only talk about them?
Who speaks, and who is only seen?
lenses.evidence: who speaks and how much (paper edit summary or sound column); what each person does on screen

green.en: The main people are full and active; we see them choose and change.
green.ar: الأشخاص الرئيسيون كاملون وفاعلون؛ نراهم يختارون ويتغيّرون.

amber.en: The main subject is full, but others are thin or only talk.
amber.ar: الشخصية الرئيسية كاملة، لكن الآخرين باهتون أو يتكلمون فقط.

red.en: People are props for the topic: we never learn what they want.
red.ar: الأشخاص أدوات للموضوع: لا نعرف أبداً ماذا يريدون.

lenses.name: Ethics and representation
ask: Are reconstructions, staged moments and joined quotes marked or true to what happened?
Is anyone shown in a way they might not recognise or accept (workers, migrants, women, minors, the vulnerable)?
Could the film harm someone in it, and has that been thought through?
lenses.evidence: reconstruction or staging in the picture column; who is unnamed or voiceless; ✂ joins in a paper edit

green.en: Reconstructions are marked, quotes keep their meaning, and everyone is shown fairly.
green.ar: إعادة التمثيل معلنة، والاقتباسات تحفظ معناها، والجميع يُعرض بإنصاف.

amber.en: A reconstruction is unmarked, or someone is shown without a name or voice where they had one.
amber.ar: إعادة تمثيل غير معلنة، أو شخص يُعرض بلا اسم أو صوت مع أن له صوتاً.

red.en: The film misrepresents someone or could harm them, and the plan doesn't address it.
red.ar: الفيلم يشوّه صورة أحد أو قد يؤذيه، والخطة لا تعالج ذلك.

lenses.name: Access
ask: Which planned scenes depend on someone's yes that hasn't been given?
What is the film if that person says no?
Is there access to the key moments (the launch, the decision), not only to interviews?
lenses.evidence: planned scenes with people whose agreement is unconfirmed (proposal, story map, intent)

green.en: Every key scene has access, or a fallback is planned.
green.ar: كل مشهد أساسي له وصول مؤكد، أو بديل مخطط.

amber.en: Some planned scenes depend on access not yet given, with no fallback.
amber.ar: بعض المشاهد المخططة تعتمد على وصول لم يُمنح بعد، دون بديل.

red.en: The film's core depends on access that isn't there.
red.ar: جوهر الفيلم يعتمد على وصول غير موجود.

lenses.name: Visual approach
ask: Is the visual approach (observational, constructed, archive-led) clear and consistent?
Is there variety, or does one shot repeat?
Does each picture do work, or only illustrate the sound?
lenses.evidence: the picture column: shot kinds, repetition, what each image adds beyond the words

green.en: A clear, consistent visual approach; pictures add meaning beyond the words.
green.ar: مقاربة بصرية واضحة ومتسقة؛ الصور تضيف معنى يتجاوز الكلام.

amber.en: The approach is clear but repetitive, or pictures mostly illustrate the words.
amber.ar: المقاربة واضحة لكنها مكررة، أو الصور في الغالب توضّح الكلام فقط.

red.en: No visual idea: pictures are wallpaper under talk.
red.ar: لا فكرة بصرية: الصور خلفية تحت الكلام.

lenses.name: Sound
ask: Does the sound plan carry the film (ambience, voices, silence, music)?
Is interview sound clean enough for the plan (workshops, sea, wind)?
Is music doing work, or covering gaps?
lenses.evidence: the sound column: ambience, speech, narration, music; locations that are noisy

green.en: Sound is a full part of the storytelling and the plan is recordable.
green.ar: الصوت جزء كامل من السرد، والخطة قابلة للتسجيل.

amber.en: Sound is planned but thin, or a noisy location threatens the interviews.
amber.ar: الصوت مخطط لكنه قليل، أو موقع صاخب يهدد المقابلات.

red.en: Sound is an afterthought; the film relies on narration or music to work.
red.ar: الصوت فكرة لاحقة؛ الفيلم يعتمد على التعليق أو الموسيقى ليعمل.

lenses.name: Archive and rights
ask: Which archive (photos, footage, music) is planned, and who owns each piece?
Is the cost and clearance time of archive realistic for the budget and schedule?
Is archive used truthfully (right place, right date)?
lenses.evidence: every archive item in the picture or sound column; its source and owner if named

green.en: Every archive item has a known owner and a clearance plan.
green.ar: لكل مادة أرشيفية مالك معروف وخطة لتصريحها.

amber.en: Some archive has no known owner or rights plan, or may cost more than budgeted.
amber.ar: بعض الأرشيف بلا مالك معروف أو خطة حقوق، أو قد يكلّف أكثر من الميزانية.

red.en: The film depends on archive it may not be able to clear.
red.ar: الفيلم يعتمد على أرشيف قد لا يُصرَّح باستخدامه.

lenses.name: Festival and broadcaster fit
ask: What length and slot is this (TV hour, 52 minutes, feature, short)?
Which audiences and outlets fit (only name ones you know accept this kind of film)?
What would a commissioner or programmer ask first?
lenses.evidence: running time target; subject; approach; outlets only when you know them for certain

green.en: Length, approach and subject fit a clear set of outlets.
green.ar: الطول والأسلوب والموضوع تناسب جهات عرض واضحة.

amber.en: It fits, but the length or approach narrows the outlets; say which.
amber.ar: يناسب، لكن الطول أو الأسلوب يضيّق جهات العرض؛ قل أيها.

red.en: No clear outlet for this length and approach.
red.ar: لا جهة عرض واضحة لهذا الطول والأسلوب.
